name: integration-card
title: Integration card
description: A list of integrations; each row opens into a card with what it does and a connect button.

props.name: title
props.description: The heading of the list, also the name of the card. Default “Integrations”.

props.name: items
props.description: The integrations to list; each row opens into a detail dialog.

props.name: onConnectChange
props.description: Called with the item id and the new state when the connect button is pressed. The state changes once the returned promise resolves.

props.name: connectLabel
props.description: The text on the button that connects an integration. Default “Connect”.

props.name: connectedLabel
props.description: The text on the badge of a connected row. Default “Connected”.

props.name: disconnectLabel
props.description: The text on the button that disconnects an integration. Default “Disconnect”.

props.name: triggersLabel
props.description: The heading above the triggers list in the dialog. Default “Triggers”.

props.name: actionsLabel
props.description: The heading above the actions list in the dialog. Default “Actions”.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: The accessible name of the close button in the dialog. Default “Close”.

a11y.text: Each row is a button. The open view is a non-modal dialog inside the card, so Tab moves on to the rest of the page as usual. Escape closes it. Focus moves to the close button on open and returns to the row on close.

The section is labelled by title. Rows have aria-haspopup="dialog" and a connected badge reads connectedLabel. The open view is a dialog labelled by its heading with aria-modal="false". The connect button uses aria-disabled and aria-busy while the call runs. The close button is named by closeLabel.
The open view uses Motion with reduced motion set to user.
